market_definition: The India Luggage Delivery Service Market comprises paid logistics services that collect, transport, and deliver travelers' personal luggage, suitcases, excess baggage, sports equipment, student belongings, and business travel baggage between specified locations within India or between India and international destinations. The market covers luggage delivery through road, air, rail, and multimodal transportation, including doorstep pickup, airport transfers, railway station transfers, and customized delivery arrangements. INCLUDED: paid door-to-door luggage pickup and delivery services; airport-to-home, airport-to-hotel, and hotel-to-airport luggage transfers; railway station-related luggage collection and delivery; domestic and international luggage shipping involving India; student, corporate, sports, and excess baggage delivery; road, air, rail, and multimodal luggage transportation; standard and customized luggage delivery services; online and offline luggage delivery bookings. EXCLUDED: regular airline checked baggage included in passenger tickets; standard airline excess baggage fees without a separate delivery service; personal luggage carried directly by passengers without a separate delivery service; international luggage deliveries with no Indian pickup or delivery point; commercial freight, bulk industrial cargo, and regular e-commerce parcel deliveries; passenger transportation, airline tickets, and railway tickets; standalone luggage storage, packaging, and insurance services; household relocation services covering furniture, appliances, and complete household moves. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - LUGGAGE DELIVERY SERVICE PROVIDER: a company headquartered in India that performs paid luggage pickup and delivery for travellers - dedicated luggage and excess-baggage shippers, plus couriers, logistics companies and packers & movers that offer a distinct luggage / baggage delivery service. Mandatory companies: Fly my Luggage, Campus2home, Shipkar, Avaan Excess, Blue Dart, Delhivery, DTDC, Om Packers and Movers, Moving Force India Packers & Movers.
who_is_included: SERVICE PROVIDER DEFINITION (services market): a company that PERFORMS this service commercially for third-party customers - it is contracted to do the work, or sells the course, inspection, survey or certification as its own offering. Operators, contractors, consultancies, accredited training organisations and certification bodies all qualify when this work is what customers pay them for. EXCLUDED: manufacturers whose only service is support or familiarisation for their own products; equipment sellers with no service delivery; marketplaces and directories that merely list providers. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
